 Microsoft services back online after global outage
 Users worldwide reported login failures and inbox errors before Microsoft restored services after an outage lasting about an hour 
 ynet | Add a comment Print Find an error? Report us Related Topics Microsoft Email Tens of thousands of users worldwide reported problems accessing Microsoft services Thursday, with Outlook and Microsoft 365 among the products affected during an outage that lasted about an hour. Users reported login failures, error messages and difficulty accessing inboxes across multiple countries. Microsoft said the disruption affected Exchange Online connectivity and began investigating the issue. ( Photo: shutterstock ) The outage prevented some users from reaching their mailboxes through Outlook and other Microsoft 365 services. Microsoft did not initially disclose the full number of customers affected. Service was restored after roughly an hour, bringing the disruption to an end. Microsoft did not immediately provide a detailed explanation for the cause of the outage.
